If you have sudden pain or a red, swollen knee after heavy use, apply a cold compress for 15-20 minutes to reduce blood flow and ease the inflammation. But if you only have tightness and stiff joints in the morning, use a warm compress to help relax the muscles and stimulate the flow of joint fluid so the joint works more smoothly
